checks.what: Roman gain in 261 from macrianus-and-quietus. The page supports the year and the parties: Macrianus and Quietus 'quickly took over most of the East (Egypt, Syria and Asia)', 'Both Macrianus were eventually defeated at Illyricum by Aureolus', Quietus 'sieged by Odaenathus in Emesa with Ballista and killed', and the East 'eventually pacified by Odaenathus', named Dux Romanorum by Gallienus. The region was too wide (Syria, Lebanon, Israel and Anatolia within Roman 259, 2,785 cells). The trial showed two side effects. (1) A same-year event settles a cell first, so the gain beat the palmyrene-empire_261 keyframe: 427 cells of Syria, Phoenice and Palaestina were drawn as Roman in 261, where the published draft has them Palmyrene. The window agent's own note meant them to be Odaenathus's. (2) It gave Rome the 87 Osroene cells in 261. Both the Sasanian dossier (sasanian-empire_261) and the Palmyrene dossier (ledger/3) have Osroene Persian until spring 262, and the page's 'Asia' does not cover it. After the fix the region is 2,064 cells. In the trial, 261 reads Rome 2,062 (Anatolia), Palmyra 634 (all 810 cells of Syria, Lebanon and Judaea), and nobody 2,098 (Egypt under the usurper Aemilianus, plus Osroene). 262-269 are unchanged from the window's own trial.
checks.fix: Region narrowed to {minus: [{intersect: [Anatolia, Cliopatria Roman Empire 259]}, {union: [Osroene, Nusaybin 100 km]}]}, 2,064 cells. Note and text rewritten to say why Syria, Lebanon, Israel and Osroene are left out (reviewer's correction).

checks.what: Roman gain in 262 of Egypt within Roman 259 (2,009 cells), from nobody. Page: Aemilianus 'c. 261 - 262 (Egypt)', 'Defeated by Aurelius Theodotus'. In the trial Egypt is nobody's in 261 (Aemilianus, who has no dossier) and Roman from 262. In October 270 the Palmyrene Nile-valley gain takes 434 cells as the dossier says, and Egypt is Roman again in 272. The region is Egypt as Rome held it, no wider.

Sasanian vassal_start in 252 over caucasian-albania. Page: 'In 252, Caucasian Albania acknowledged the suzerainty of the Sasanian Empire'; 'Albania became a vassal state of the Sassanid Empire, but retained its monarchy'. The region (Albania 259 minus Karabakh, 179 cells, 178 held) is the dossier's own caucasian-albania_260 keyframe. That fits the page: 'the Kura River (Cyros) the frontier between Armenia and Albania', and Artsakh and Utik stayed Armenian until 387. In the trial Albania is drawn as a Sasanian vassal from 252 to 299, where the published draft has Sasanian direct rule 260-286 and nobody 287-299. The relation stays open at 300. The Roman protectorate of 297 is not drawn (see problems).

Roman gain in 271 of Anatolia within Roman 259 (2,151 cells), from nobody, so it takes only nobody's cells. Page: 'In 271, Zabbai started the operations in Asia Minor'; 'The Palmyrenes subdued Galatia, and occupied Ancyra'; 'In 272, Aurelian crossed the Bosphorus and advanced quickly through Anatolia'. So Cilicia and Cappadocia were never Palmyrene. In the trial the 646 cells the 270 keyframes drop are nobody's in 270 only. In 271 they are Roman, with Galatia Palmyrene (ledger/9), leaving 1 grey cell. 2,151 cells were nobody's in 272-282 in the published draft (480 cells a year). After the patch 88 Osroene cells remain grey, a problem that was already there. The page does not support the grey year 270, which comes from roman-empire ledger/96 and the roman-empire_270 keyframe (see problems).

Murong loss in 236, to nobody, of Cliopatria's Xianbei 224 shape outside the Murong home ground (3,009 cells). Page: Kebineng 'was assassinated by a Cao Wei agent in 235, after which his confederacy disintegrated'. The Murong moved 'deeper into the Liaodong Peninsula' and helped Wei against the Gongsun in 238. The Duan were in Liaoxi, the Yuwen 'between the Luan River and Liucheng', and the Tuoba settled at Shengle only in 258. No Murong rule over Inner Mongolia or Shanxi is mentioned. The subtracted home ground is exactly the murong-xianbei_235 keyframe spec (130 cells), which stays Murong's all through (a Wei vassal 235-265, a Jin vassal from 289). In the trial: Murong holds 2,188 cells in 235 only (the dissolve acts at the end of the year), and 53 of the Xianbei 224 shape from 236. The 1,895-cell snap at 285 is gone. The quote 'The Murong settled in Liaodong' paraphrases the page.

Sasanian gain c. 240 of Sistan (256 cells: Iranian Sistan north of 29.5 N plus Nimroz), from nobody. Page: 'The province was formed in ca. 240, during the reign of Shapur I'; capital Zrang; Narseh governed to 271, then Hormizd, whose c. 281 revolt was put down in 283. The extent is 'Mostly corresponding to ... Drangiana', 'extending across the borders of south-western Afghanistan', so the region stays within the page. In the trial the 133 Nimroz cells are nobody's in 238-239 only (published draft: 238-282). They are Sasanian from 240 to 299.

shu-han_224, now covering 225-237: Cliopatria Shu 224 plus all of Chongqing, Yunnan and Guizhou. Page: 'based in the area around present-day Hanzhong, Sichuan, Chongqing, Yunnan, Guizhou, and north Guangxi'; Zhuge Liang 'launched an expeditionary force there in 225 to quell local rebellions'. The year 225 and the Nanzhong extent are supported. The whole-Guizhou leaf also claimed the 21 south-east Guizhou cells (Liping/Congjiang, about 109.3 E 26.5 N), which Cliopatria's Eastern Wu shape of 238-270 holds and the draft gives Wu from 224 to 280. Wu kept them in 225-237 by the size rule. From 238, under the same leaf in overrides/1, Shu took them, and at Shu's fall in 263 they went to nobody, so the corner went Wu, Shu, nobody, Wu (264-270) with no event. After the fix, Shu holds 4,510 cells for 225-263 and Wu keeps the corner throughout. The shu-han_238 snap and the eastern-wu/shu-han conflict change are gone.

Palmyra in Asia Minor: roman-empire ledger/96 (267, a loss to palmyrene-empire of Levant, Judaea, Cilicia, Galatia and Cappadocia) gives Palmyra about 640 Anatolian cells in 267-269. The roman-empire_270 keyframe also cuts Cilicia, Galatia and Cappadocia, so 646 cells are grey in 270. The Palmyrene Empire page dates the Asia Minor campaign to 271 ('In 271, Zabbai started the operations in Asia Minor'). Dossier fix: narrow ledger/96 to Levant and Roman Judaea, and the roman-empire_270 correction to minus Levant and Roman Judaea only (Galatia goes in 271 by palmyrene-empire ledger/9). events/3 then moves nothing and can stay. This repeats the window agent's request on palmyrene-empire.

Osroene/Nisibis: 87 cells are nobody's in 261. macrianus-and-quietus's found/keyframe region (Anatolia within Roman 259) takes them from the Sasanian in 260 by the size rule, and its dissolve releases them. Sasanian and Palmyrene dossiers both hold Osroene Persian until spring 262. Dossier fix: subtract {union: [Osroene, Nusaybin 100 km]} from macrianus-and-quietus's found, keyframe and dissolve regions. Separately, 88 Osroene cells are grey from 272 to 299 (none of the 272 Roman and Palmyrene events cover them). This was already the case before the patch: 480 cells were grey in 272-282 in the published draft.

Caucasian Albania after 297: events/2's Sasanian suzerainty has no end. The page says 'In 297 the treaty of Nisibis stipulated the reestablishment of the Roman protectorate over Caucasian Iberia and Albania' and 'fifty years later Rome lost the area'. 297-299 is drawn as a Sasanian vassal. The relation is open at the p0300 anchor (178 cells), so the p0300-p0399 window inherits it. Fix if wanted: patch events in 297, sasanian-empire vassal_end and roman-empire vassal_start with counterpart caucasian-albania over the events/2 region, source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caucasian_Albania. Tell the p0300 window to close the Roman relation and reopen the Sasanian one. The R2 successor issue (the window agent's dossier request) still stands.

Shu Han, west Sichuan: 581 cells of the Garze/Ngawa plateau are dropped at the shu-han_224 snap in 225 with no event (the published draft dropped them at 238). shu-han ledger/2 (214) and keyframes 214-219 give Shu all of admin1 Sichuan, but Cliopatria's Shu shapes and the overrides do not. Dossier fix: narrow shu-han ledger/2 and the 214/215/219 keyframes to Sichuan within Cliopatria Shu 224, plus Chongqing.

Nanzhong after 263: 918 cells of west and south Yunnan (Yongchang) are grey from 264 to 299. shu-han ledger/20 and ledger/22 hand Wei only Cliopatria Shu 261 plus Chongqing, and the Wei and Jin keyframes leave them out. In the published draft they were grey from 238. Now that Shu holds them to 263, the conquest should pass them to Wei, then Jin (Jin's Ning Province). Dossier fix: widen shu-han ledger/20 and ledger/22 to the override land, and extend the cao-wei and western-jin keyframes of 263-299 the same way. The p0300 window already patched the Ning corners for 306-323.

Murong: 2,188 cells of the old Xianbei land are still drawn as Murong (a Wei vassal) for the year 235, because the xianbei dissolve acts at the end of its year and events/4 can only release them in 236. A compiler limitation, 1 year.
